# Invite user
{: .no_toc }

Create a user and send an invitation (or create active).
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `USR-02` |
| **Route** | `/admin/users/new` · deep link `substratal://admin/users/new` |
| **Where** | Administration › Users |
| **Who can use it** | users.manage |
| **Kind** | form |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwPreferencesGroup` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Email | email-field | body.email | required | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=email |
| Display name | text-field | body.display_name | optional | AdwEntryRow |
| Send invitation email | toggle | body.send_invitation | default on | AdwSwitchRow |
| Create as active | toggle | body.status active\ | invited | AdwSwitchRow |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Invite | `POST /users (Idempotency-Key)` | 201 → USR-03. 409 → "A user with that email exists" + link. |
